claims.claim: Big tire bicycle with complete accessories

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The bicycle may not be in working condition (e.g., brakes, gears, chain, or tires may be faulty).
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo showing the brakes being applied, gears shifting, and tire pressure or tread condition.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (e.g., pedals, chain, lights, bell, or lock) may be absent.
risks.proof: A photo showing all accessories laid out next to the bicycle.

risks.risk: The frame or components may have hidden damage or rust not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the frame, joints, and welds, especially under the seat and near the bottom bracket.

proof_requests: A close-up photo or video showing the brakes, gears, chain, and tire condition.
A photo showing all accessories (pedals, chain, lights, bell, lock, etc.) laid out next to the bicycle.
A close-up photo of the frame and joints to check for damage or rust.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
